project_description:
DROWL Paragraphs for Bootstrap is the Paragraphs module that works perfectly with our DROWL Base Theme . It provides multiple Paragraphs bundles and style options .

 DROWL Paragraphs basically uses standard Bootstrap (5) classes and should therefore be compatible with any Bootstrap 5 based theme. But it's clearly designed to work with our DROWL ecosystem, which means that if you're using it, you'll need to be fully aware of its many dependencies.

 Each pre-defined Paragraph bundle is implemented in a separate sub-module so that only the bundles that are actually required can be activated.

 Features 
 We have several Paragraphs bundles available: 

 The module offers a standard set of display options, which were implemented using the UI Styles module and can therefore be easily extended/adapted (e.g. via a child theme) for the respective project.

 Known Issues 
 The UI/UX is a work in progress and will probably be for a long time.

 Supporting this Module 
 Feel free to report issues, but we have no plans to make this module explicitly compatible to other Bootstrap Themes (than DROWL Base/Radix). So you need to override templates on your own, if you need to modify something specific to your theme.
